summary: Столп 4 P0 (кейс докооборот): агент откладывает (defer) шаг → человек берёт карточку эскалации из инбокса → нажатие «Согласовать»/«Выполнить» билось в 404 «no waiting instance task with this id», потому что POST /api/inbox/:id/action искала задачу ТОЛЬКО через findWaitingInstanceTask→listInstanceInboxTasks (audit-проекция process.started/process.next_task), а agent.deferred — отдельный audit-тип, которого там никогда нет. Корень: ACCEPTED DECISION 1 (dispatch-outcome.ts) уже ЗАКРЫВАЕТ агентскую внешнюю задачу в момент defer (jobStore.complete+task_completed→completeTask в Flowable) и токен уходит ДАЛЬШЕ по BPMN — но ничто не проецировало и не давало завершить downstream userTask, на который токен уже пришёл; единственная видимая карточка (agent.deferred) не несла способа продвинуть движок. ФИКС (без нового API): POST /api/inbox/:id/action теперь, когда findWaitingInstanceTask возвращает null, дополнительно ищет строку в listDeferredInboxTasks; если найдена и несёт instanceId — пишет ОДНО audit-событие agent.defer_resolved (открытый словарь типов, без новой таблицы) и вызывает УЖЕ существующий reconcileInstanceEngineDrive в режиме resolve-by-instance (approvedTaskDefKey: undefined — тот же путь, что approve базовой задачи, T-0571 §2.1) — движок сам находит и завершает живой активный userTask инстанса. Легаси-defer без instanceId → честный 404 DEFER_NOT_ROUTABLE (человекочитаемо), не тихий no-op. Три сопутствующих дефекта того же контура тоже починены: (2) defer-строки теперь несут escalated:true → попадают во вкладку «Эскалации» и в counts.esc (раньше findInboxItems строил их без этого поля). (3) doubt_reason: новая чистая humanizeDoubtReason (defer-inbox-producer.ts) переводит ЗАКРЫТЫЙ список известных инженерных литералов ('no published instruction for agent' и т.п.) в человеко-читаемый русский — незнакомый/LLM-текст проходит НЕТРОНУТЫМ (анти-кейс: словарь констант кода, не кейс-контент); применяется и на запись (planDeferTask), и защитно на чтение (deferred-inbox-store.ts, для строк, записанных до этой задачи). (4) Честная адресация: вместо доверия хардкод-фолбэку ('role-approver'/'fin-ctrl') без проверки держателей, findInboxItems переиспользует УЖЕ существующий resolveExecutorFallbackBatch (T-0380) для defer-строк тоже — роль без держателей помечается routed_to_fallback:'role_unfilled' и резолвится на владельца тенанта (findTenantOwnerSlug), та же честная лестница, что уже применяется к instance-задачам.

mechanism.root_cause: src/http/inbox.ts POST /api/inbox/:id/action (line ~1663 pre-fix) called ONLY findWaitingInstanceTask(pool, tenantId, taskId) → listInstanceInboxTasks (reads audit_event WHERE type IN process.started/process.next_task). A defer task's id is an agent.deferred audit_event.id — a DIFFERENT audit type, structurally absent from that projection — so the lookup always returned null → unconditional 404 'no waiting instance task with this id'. Separately, ACCEPTED DECISION 1 (src/runtime/agent-dispatch/dispatch-outcome.ts, applyAgentOutcome's defer-to-human branch) already closes the agent's OWN Flowable external task at defer time (jobStore.complete + task_completed outbox → makeExternalTaskDeliver → flowableClient.completeTask) and the engine token advances downstream — but NONE of the four reconcile-on-read paths (reconcileInstanceTimers/reconcileInboxEngineDriveOnRead/surfaceMessageCatchWaits/message-delivery) fire on 'an agent-step external task just closed', so the resulting live downstream userTask was never surfaced as its own inbox row, and the ONLY visible row (the agent.deferred card) had no completion mechanism at all.
mechanism.fix_chosen: Reused the EXISTING resolve-by-instance engine-drive mechanism (reconcileInstanceEngineDrive with approvedTaskDefKey:undefined, completeEngineTask:true — the SAME code path the base process.started approve action already uses, T-0571 §2.1) rather than inventing a new engine API or trying to re-complete the agent's already-closed external task (which would be wrong: ACCEPTED DECISION 1 says that job is done; the human is not re-doing the agent's step, they are advancing whatever the engine opened next). Added a fallback lookup in the /action route: when findWaitingInstanceTask returns null, check listDeferredInboxTasks for a matching agent.deferred row; if found with a real instanceId (now threaded through via F1: deferred-inbox-store.ts reads payload.instance_id/proc_key, previously ignored despite dispatch-outcome.ts already writing them), record ONE agent.defer_resolved audit event (open-vocabulary type, D-061 no-new-table) then drive the engine exactly like an ordinary approve. Escalation-tab and honest-addressing fixes reuse existing primitives (item.escalated flag already checked by inTab('esc'); resolveExecutorFallbackBatch/findTenantOwnerSlug already used for instance tasks) rather than adding parallel logic.
mechanism.not_weakening: ACCEPTED DECISION 1 is unchanged (agent step still always closes on defer — verified by the unchanged dispatch-outcome.test.ts assertions). PDP/authz for defer-resolve reuses the IDENTICAL role-check + Tier-2-substitution + deactivation gates as the ordinary approve route (no new grant-free path). defer-no-new-table.sh (T-0221 FF-1/FF-5/FF-6/FF-7) stays green: agent.defer_resolved is an open-vocabulary audit_event.type, not a table/column; deferred-inbox-store.ts remains read-only (no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) and reads only audit_event. anti-case-lock.sh/detel-literal-baseline.sh/read-pdp-anti-case.sh stay green at their existing baselines (role-approver count unchanged at 2/3 baseline=3, aggregate unchanged at 16; the new HTTP-level unit test deliberately uses non-denylisted fixture roles fin-ctrl/e-kravtsova/e-mironov instead of role-approver/e-larina to avoid adding a new occurrence of a case-denylisted literal in this diff).
mechanism.side_effects_checked: humanizeDoubtReason is an EXACT-MATCH table over known engine-authored literals only — any string not in the table (LLM-generated agent drafts, dynamic 'model confidence N below floor M' messages) passes through byte-identical, so no diagnostic information is ever lost for an unrecognized reason (existing golden tests in defer-inbox-producer.test.ts asserting untranslated passthrough for 'model confidence too low'/'ambiguous answer' still pass unmodified). One pre-existing test (run-precheck.test.ts AC-6) asserted the RAW English substring 'instruction' in doubtReason — updated to assert the humanized Russian text instead (the raw string genuinely no longer appears, which is the intended fix for defect #3, not a regression). deferred-inbox-store.ts's `name` field is now ALWAYS rebuilt from the (humanized) doubtReason rather than trusting the stored payload.defer_name verbatim, because defer_name is a fully-derived field (planDeferTask always sets it to 'Проверить: '+doubtReason) — trusting a legacy row's pre-humanization defer_name verbatim would re-leak raw English even after the doubtReason fix landed.

defer_to_human_flow: F1 src/db/deferred-inbox-store.ts: DeferredInboxRow gains instanceId/procKey (string|null) read from payload.instance_id/payload.proc_key — additive, null for legacy rows without these fields. F2 src/http/inbox.ts POST /api/inbox/:id/action: when findWaitingInstanceTask returns null, look up the task in listDeferredInboxTasks; not found → 404 NOT_FOUND (unchanged for truly-unknown ids); found but instanceId===null → 404 DEFER_NOT_ROUTABLE (human-readable, legacy/demo-run events only); found with instanceId → authz (myRoles/Tier-2-substitution/deactivation, identical to the ordinary approve gate) → write agent.defer_resolved audit event → reconcileInstanceEngineDrive(resolve-by-instance, completeEngineTask:true) → same 200/502 response envelope as ordinary approve. F6/F7 src/http/inbox.ts findInboxItems (defer-merge block): escalated:true added to every defer InboxItem; routed_to_fallback:'role_unfilled' applied via resolveExecutorFallbackBatch for defer rows whose role has no confirmed holders. F3 src/core/defer-inbox-producer.ts: humanizeDoubtReason exact-match table wired into planDeferTask; deferred-inbox-store.ts applies it defensively on read too and always rebuilds `name` from the humanized doubtReason. F4 web/src/screens/screen-inbox.jsx: ACTION_ERROR_MESSAGE.DEFER_NOT_ROUTABLE added.
escalation_tab: src/http/inbox.ts findInboxItems's defer-merge block now sets escalated:true on every InboxItem built from a listDeferredInboxTasks row — inTab('esc', item, ...) already checked item.escalated===true (unchanged), so GET /api/inbox?tab=esc and counts.esc now include defer tasks without any change to the tab-filtering logic itself. Verified live-DB in ci/checks/db/inbox-defer-escalation.db.test.ts (AC-b).
human_readable_reason: src/core/defer-inbox-producer.ts's new humanizeDoubtReason(raw) maps the closed set of engine-authored doubtReason literals (no published instruction for agent / llm runtime dormant — inference not available / llm runtime dormant — no inference available / autonomy threshold not met / answer marked ambiguous / critical operation — agent never executes critical steps (F3); escalated to human / instance budget exhausted — deferred to human) to Russian sentences; anything else (LLM drafts, dynamic confidence messages) passes through unchanged. Wired into planDeferTask (write path, both run-precheck.ts and dispatch-outcome.ts consumers) and defensively into deferred-inbox-store.ts (read path, covers rows written before this fix).
honest_addressing: Defer role is still authored via ctx.roleId (the agent's own assigned role) with a config-primitive fallback (resolveDefaultApproverRole()) at WRITE time — unchanged, since that is a legitimate per-agent authoring choice, not a hardcode-without-verification. The actual honesty fix is on READ: src/http/inbox.ts's findInboxItems reuses the existing T-0380 resolveExecutorFallbackBatch (the SAME mechanism already protecting ordinary instance pool tasks) for defer rows — a defer task addressed to a role with zero confirmed holders in the tenant gets routed_to_fallback:'role_unfilled' and resolves to the tenant owner (findTenantOwnerSlug), instead of silently being unclaimable by anyone. Verified live-DB in ci/checks/db/inbox-defer-escalation.db.test.ts (AC-d, both the unfilled-role case and the has-holders no-regression case).

The FULL cycle 'agent defers → human claims the defer card → human clicks Согласовать/Выполнить → engine advances' is reproduced end-to-end with a FAKE FlowableClient in src/__tests__/inbox-defer-resolve.test.ts's AC-a test ('approving a defer task (with instanceId) returns 200 and drives the engine (resolve-by-instance)') — asserts 200 (not the old 404), mockClient.completeUserTask called with the resolved live engine task id, and an agent.defer_resolved audit event recorded with the correct instance_id/inbox_task_id. A REAL Flowable/browser LIVE_PROOF (per D-064 discipline) requires promotion to dev + a deployed stand with a real agentTask-authored BPMN process and a real LLM key (T-0460's ADR notes no seed BPMN currently authors an agentTask at all — this is genuinely greenfield wiring) and should be run by the founder/poehali orchestrator on the next promoted stand, not from this isolated worktree.
